blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Magnolia extended its winning streak to four straight games in the resumption of its 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup campaign after holding off Blackwater, 107-101, on Friday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Jerom Lastimosa leaned on a strong first half on his way to 24 points and seven assists while import KJ Buffen produced 24 points and 20 rebounds as Magnolia tightened its grip on the top four spot in Group B with a 5-3 record. The Hotshots remained in position to secure a quarterfinals berth with two games left in the group stage as they set their sights on Sunday’s marquee […]...
